name: Proposals for decisions
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the budget of the European Public Prosecutor’s Office for the financial year 2024
part_text:
The European Parliament approves how the European Public Prosecutor's Office spent its 2024 budget and closes its accounts for that year. It also asks for more money and staff for the office, which investigates fraud against the European Union's budget. The office's workload keeps rising fast, and Parliament says its resources are too small. Parliament also wants clearer rules on recovering money from criminals, better protection of the office's computer systems, and Hungary to join the office.

- Parliament approves the office's 2024 spending and closes its accounts.
- The office and the European Commission are asked to fix staffing and funding gaps.
- Hungary is urged to join; the Commission should report back on resource needs.
